This '''asteroid base''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] built into an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] over [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] that repeatedly fell into the hands of both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After the Empire fell, the space station changed hands for the final known time, having been retaken by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
